greeting.text: There are things that cling to a man that no sword cuts away. If you carry something cursed, I can lift it, and it will crumble to ash as it goes.

effects.message: The priest lays a hand on your brow and speaks a few quiet words. The cursed thing crumbles, and the weight goes out of you.

lifted.text: Go in peace, and be careful what you pick up in the dark.
